answer: Agents bond stake to join an epoch and evaluate a polynomial commitment that binds each Semaphore identity to its rate-limit nullifier. A valid RLN proof exposes a Shamir share derived from the private key; two proofs reusing the same nullifier in that epoch provide enough shares to reconstruct the key, proving abuse and triggering immediate collateral slashing. The lotus rule is simple: one signal per quota; duplicate signals carve a canyon through anonymity.
